manifest.name: dsh-gxworks
manifest.description: Read, generate and edit Mitsubishi PLC projects in DeepSeek Harness. Includes the GXWorks Agent MCP backend for Windows x64. GitHub project at https://github.com/Arienax/dsh-gxworks
manifest.author: Arienax

bundle.text:
# ============================================================================
# dsh-gxworks —— 把 GXWorks Agent 的 MCP 服务与路由 Skill 挂进 DeepSeek Harness
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 这一层 patch 只做两件事：
#   1. 用 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 以 stdio 方式启动本机 GXWorks Agent MCP，
#      工具在会话里呈现为 mcp__gxworks__<原始工具名>。
#   2. 用 @deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem 注册一个只扫描本包 skills/ 的
#      独立技能源（providerName: gxworks），把 gxworks-mcp-router 技能带进目录。
#
# 启动参数由 launch/mcp-launch.mjs 解析：默认使用包内完整 MCP 后端，
# 首次启动本地解压，后续复用；无需另装 Python 或 GXWorks Agent。安装根依次取
# --agent-root、GXWORKS_AGENT_ROOT/GXWORKS_AGENT_HOME、%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\
# dsh-gxworks\settings.json（由 --set-root 写入）、内置后端、当前目录上级、PATH。
# 工作区可用 GXWORKS_MCP_WORKSPACE_DIR 覆盖；需要连接已启动的 Web 工作台时，
# 在下面的 args 里加 '--service'。
#
# 两个 baseUrl 表达式都先按“本 patch 所在目录”解析，再退回按包名解析，
# 因此工作区链接安装与 profile 安装都能找到同一份 launch/ 与 skills/。
# ============================================================================

- insert:
    - id: gxworks-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: gxworks
        transport: stdio
        command: !!js process.execPath
        args: !!js "(() => { const fs = process.getBuiltinModule('node:fs'); const p = process.getBuiltinModule('node:path'); const u = process.getBuiltinModule('node:url'); const m = process.getBuiltinModule('node:module'); const beside = p.join(u.fileURLToPath(baseUrl), 'launch', 'mcp-launch.mjs'); if (fs.existsSync(beside)) return [beside]; const pkg = m.createRequire(baseUrl).resolve('dsh-gxworks/package.json'); return [p.join(p.dirname(pkg), 'launch', 'mcp-launch.mjs')]; })()"
        # 原生编译、冷重开与仿真采样都可能超过默认 60 秒。
        toolCallTimeoutMs: 600000
        # 后端准备或连接失败时不阻止整个 Harness 启动，
        # 失败原因写在 Harness 日志里。
        failOnStartupError: false
        reconnect:
          enabled: true
          maxAttempts: 3

    - id: gxworks-skills
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
      config:
        providerName: gxworks
        # 只提供本包自带的技能，不重复扫描工程与用户技能目录。
        includeDefaultRoots: false
        watch: true
        customSkillDirs: !!js "(() => { const fs = process.getBuiltinModule('node:fs'); const p = process.getBuiltinModule('node:path'); const u = process.getBuiltinModule('node:url'); const m = process.getBuiltinModule('node:module'); const beside = p.join(u.fileURLToPath(baseUrl), 'skills'); if (fs.existsSync(beside)) return [beside]; const pkg = m.createRequire(baseUrl).resolve('dsh-gxworks/package.json'); return [p.join(p.dirname(pkg), 'skills')]; })()"

    # 本包自己的 Host 模块（index.mjs）：校验安装内容和会话中用户需求的来源。
    # id 与包名一致，patch 覆盖时按它定位。
    - id: dsh-gxworks
      name: 'dsh-gxworks'

readme.text:
将 [GXWorks Agent](https://github.com/Arienax/gxworks-agent) 封装为 DeepSeek Harness 插件。你可以在对话中读取 GXW 工程、生成程序候选、离线修改支持的程序对象，处理梯形图（Ladder）、ST、FBD 和 SFC 任务。

插件内置 MCP 后端，并注册 `gxworks-mcp-router` 技能，为当前任务选择工具。后端首次启动时在本地解压，后续直接复用，无需另装 Python。原生编译需要本机安装 GX Works2，仿真观察需要 Simulator2。

需要 Windows x64、Node.js ≥ 22.12 和 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x（含预发布版）。将 `web` 换成你使用的 profile。

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-gxworks
```

从 GitHub 安装可用 `dsh plugin --profile web add github:Arienax/dsh-gxworks`。使用插件市场时，添加[市场索引](https://arienax.github.io/dsh-gxworks/index.json)即可找到本插件。

安装后可以在同一 profile 的对话中试试这些指令。

新建程序默认先走 Design，选定方案后按规格生成。说“直接生成”即可走 Direct。新建 Ladder 时，Desktop 按 CPU 查手册，在适用的梯级复用移位或搬运片段，一次生成一份程序。开始验证时会在聊天中提示一次。片段检查无法判断外部写入的触发关系时保留候选并提示未验证，不因保护条件写法不同而拒绝。后端按已确认的行为条件或独立 I/O 用例回放，只在发现明确反例时追加一次局部修正。结果会单列尚未验证的行为。[独立用例格式](runtime/README.md#independent-io-cases)

- “列出我的 PLC 工程。”—— 调用 `mcp__gxworks__list_projects`，也可用来确认插件已连接。
- “GX Works2 安装在哪里？有打开的工程吗？”—— `mcp__gxworks__list_gxworks2_sessions` 返回后端检测到的可执行文件路径，并单独列出窗口与工程状态。
- “读取这个 GXW 文件，说明 MAIN 程序的启动条件。”—— 在对话中提供工程文件路径。

更新用 `dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-gxworks`，卸载用 `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-gxworks`。

[English](README.en.md)

This plugin brings [GXWorks Agent](https://github.com/Arienax/gxworks-agent) into DeepSeek Harness for Ladder, ST, FBD and SFC tasks. Use chat to read GXW projects, generate program candidates and edit supported program objects offline.

The plugin bundles the MCP backend and registers the `gxworks-mcp-router` skill to select tools for each task. It extracts the backend locally on first use and reuses it on later launches. No separate Python installation is required. Native compilation requires a local GX Works2 installation, and simulation observation requires Simulator2.

Requires Windows x64, Node.js ≥ 22.12 and DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x (including prereleases). Replace `web` with your profile name.

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-gxworks
```

To install from GitHub, use `dsh plugin --profile web add github:Arienax/dsh-gxworks`. To find the plugin in the marketplace, add the [market index](https://arienax.github.io/dsh-gxworks/index.json).

New programs start in Design mode and use the approach you confirm. Say “direct mode” or use /gxworks-direct to generate immediately. For new Ladder programs, Desktop reads the CPU-specific manual and can use executable shift or copy fragments in a single generation. A chat notice appears once when verification starts. Unresolved external writes to fragment storage remain advisory; the candidate is preserved even when its guard uses a different form. The backend can replay confirmed behavior conditions or independent I/O cases. A definite counterexample allows one repair of the affected networks. The result identifies behavior that still needs verification. [Independent case format](runtime/README.md#independent-io-cases)

- “List my PLC projects.” This calls `mcp__gxworks__list_projects` and lets you check that the plugin is connected.
- “Where is GX Works2 installed, and is a project open?” The `mcp__gxworks__list_gxworks2_sessions` tool reports the executable path detected by the backend and lists open windows and their project state separately.
- “Read this GXW file and explain the start conditions in MAIN.” Include the path to the project file.

To update, run `dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-gxworks`. To uninstall, run `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-gxworks`.
